ticket.title: Production system completely down - all users affected
ticket.description: Our entire platform is down since 2 AM. Zero users can log in. We are a healthcare provider and this is affecting patient scheduling. Every minute of downtime costs us $10k. Our CEO has been paged. This is completely unacceptable.

ticket.title: Question about billing cycle dates
ticket.description: Hi, I wanted to check when our next billing cycle starts. We're planning our budget for next quarter and want to make sure we have the right dates.

ticket.title: API rate limits hitting during business hours
ticket.description: We're seeing 429 errors between 9 AM - 12 PM EST every day this week. Our automated jobs are failing and we're having to manually retry. Would appreciate guidance on best practices.

ticket.title: Request for SAML SSO documentation
ticket.description: Could you point me to the latest SAML SSO setup guide? We're onboarding a new enterprise customer and want to help them configure SSO integration with their Okta instance.

ticket.title: Data breach suspected - unauthorized access detected
ticket.description: Our security team has detected logins from IP addresses in countries we have no operations in. This started 3 hours ago. We suspect our account may be compromised. We need immediate investigation and account lockdown. We are filing a formal security incident report.

ticket.title: Feature request: bulk user import via CSV
ticket.description: It would be great if we could import users in bulk via CSV instead of one at a time. We're onboarding 200 new employees next month and the manual process will take forever. Love the product overall!

ticket.title: Reports showing incorrect data since last update
ticket.description: Since your 3.2.1 update on Monday, our revenue reports are off by approximately 15%. We've compared against our source data and the discrepancy is consistent. Our CFO uses these reports for board presentations. This has to be fixed before our board meeting Friday.

ticket.title: Slow dashboard load times
ticket.description: Our main dashboard has been taking about 8 seconds to load this week. Previously it was under 2 seconds. Not critical but it's affecting productivity.

ticket.title: We are canceling our subscription
ticket.description: After 18 months, we've made the decision to cancel our subscription at renewal. The product hasn't delivered the ROI we expected, and we've found a competitor that better fits our needs. Please contact our finance team to process the cancellation.

ticket.title: Webhook delivery failures intermittent
ticket.description: About 5-10% of our webhook events aren't being delivered. I've confirmed our endpoint is healthy and returning 200s. Started about 4 days ago. Our real-time notifications are unreliable as a result.

ticket.title: Integration with Salesforce not syncing
ticket.description: Our Salesforce sync has been broken for 2 weeks. We've lost confidence in the data. I've opened 2 tickets about this already and haven't gotten a real fix. We're seriously considering alternatives at this point. This is affecting our entire sales team.

ticket.title: How do I export audit logs?
ticket.description: Hi team, new to the platform. Could someone walk me through how to export audit logs? I've checked the docs but couldn't find the specific steps. Thanks!

ticket.title: Memory leak causing app crashes every 6-8 hours
ticket.description: Our server running your SDK is experiencing memory growth that leads to crashes every 6-8 hours. We've isolated it to your SDK with heap profiling. We have to restart every night. This is affecting our SLA commitments to our own customers.

ticket.title: Thank you for the amazing support!
ticket.description: Just wanted to say a huge thank you to the support team. The recent issue we had with our integrations was resolved quickly and professionally. The team went above and beyond. Please pass our thanks along!

ticket.title: Login failures for 30% of our users
ticket.description: Since 10 AM today, about 30% of our users are unable to log in. They're getting 'authentication failed' errors. We've confirmed it's not a password issue. Our support inbox is getting flooded.

ticket.title: Overage charges not matching usage dashboard
ticket.description: Our invoice shows $3,500 in API overage but our usage dashboard shows we were well under the limit. There's a clear discrepancy. We are disputing this charge and will not pay until it's resolved.

ticket.title: Custom fields not appearing in API responses
ticket.description: We added custom fields to our account last week but they're not showing up in API responses. This is blocking a project we have in flight. Would appreciate a fix or workaround.

ticket.title: Request to update our company name in account
ticket.description: We recently rebranded from 'Acme Corp' to 'Nexus Solutions'. Could you please update our account name and any associated invoices going forward? No rush.

ticket.title: Database migration stuck at 73% for 48 hours
ticket.description: We started a data migration 48 hours ago and it's been stuck at 73% since hour 6. Support told us to wait but it's now been 2 days. Our entire team is blocked. We cannot go live with our product. This is devastating for our business.

ticket.title: Mobile app crashes on iOS 17.4
ticket.description: Our team noticed the mobile app crashes on launch for users running iOS 17.4. About 20% of our users are on this version. Not all features are critical on mobile but it's a bad experience.
